name: hash_encode
description: Hash, encode, and decode data. Supports MD5, SHA256, base64, URL-encoding, and JWT decoding.

manual.overview: Use when you need to hash, encode, or decode data—checksums, base64, URL-encoding, or JWT inspection.
tips: Use sha256 for integrity checks; md5 is weaker and deprecated for security
jwt_decode only reads payload; it does not verify signature
url_encode handles spaces and special chars for query strings
edge_cases: Invalid base64 or malformed JWT will raise decode errors
jwt_decode reveals payload—never log tokens with secrets

executor.command: python -c "import hashlib, base64, urllib.parse, json; action='{{args.action}}'; inp='{{args.input}}'; r={'md5':lambda:hashlib.md5(inp.encode()).hexdigest(),'sha256':lambda:hashlib.sha256(inp.encode()).hexdigest(),'base64_encode':lambda:base64.b64encode(inp.encode()).decode(),'base64_decode':lambda:base64.b64decode(inp).decode(),'url_encode':lambda:urllib.parse.quote(inp),'url_decode':lambda:urllib.parse.unquote(inp),'jwt_decode':lambda:json.dumps(json.loads(base64.b64decode(inp.split('.')[1]+'==').decode()),indent=2)}[action](); print(r)"
